message: Hey everyone! So, we had a little blackout the other night, and it turned into quite the family chat. We shared our go-to snacks, made sure the kids were entertained with games, and compared flashlight sources—who knew Grandma's old lantern would steal the show? 😄 If you're ever caught in the dark, I found a handy resource that covers some great tips for staying safe and cozy. What’s your favorite way to make the best of a power outage?
